## Appearance

The Rev. [James](../character/james-a.md) Perry is a sleek, rubicund man with a shining bald head. His face is framed by bushy white eyebrows and a bristling white moustache.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)_

## Personality

Perry is described as a tiresome and pompous individual. Even at an earlier time, he was considered a most detestable prig, lacking physical attractiveness.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P20](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0020)_

## History

Perry grew up in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) and attended school alongside [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), where he was known as a detestable little prig. As an adult, he visited [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) as a guest minister and unwittingly ate Faith's pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), for Sunday dinner while patronizing the family. Later that evening in the study, his coat-tails caught fire from the hearth while [Faith](../character/faith.md) silently watched without warning him.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P1](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII.
